model_pose_source_scope: Gazebo actual moving_obstacle pose only, for fixture/evaluation; not connected to NAV
entry_scope: Frozen fixture enters only during early real SLAM forward progress .10.. .30m; a missed window does not move the obstacle into a nearby robot

clear_semantics.sensor_corridor_clear: NAV condition: actual registered pointcloud guard reports a clear corridor continuously for1sim s, plus a new actual SCAN trajectory and measured stop; independent of mover phase or Gazebo model pose
clear_semantics.actual_model_withdrawal_complete: Separate final fixture condition: actual observed moving_obstacle returns within5mm to initial position; mover phase clear denotes this condition only
clear_semantics.parking_evaluation_window: At least5sim s within actual model-confirmed blocking phase; continuous measured stop and frozen parking thresholds apply
clear_semantics.xyz_evidence: Capture entering/blocking/leaving plus at least5sim s after actual-model withdrawal complete
